## Introduction

@fig-runtime plots runtime against revenue with rating as the independent variable and rating as the dependent variable.

## Plot

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-cap: "Runtime against rating"
#| label: fig-runtime
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films['runtime_min'], films['imdb_rating'}
```

```{python}
#| echo: true
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
